features.title: Bounded compaction summaries
features.summary: Summarizes oversized conversation history in bounded, tool-balanced requests before the native durable compaction transaction commits.
failureModes: A system prompt, tool catalog, or one indivisible tool transaction can exceed the safe request budget; compaction fails without rewriting the session history.
An image-bearing request without model-declared image pricing cannot be safely sized and fails before dispatch.

verification.testName: splits oversized input while keeping tool calls with their results

verification.reason: This Host-only backend has no browser-owned surface; its behavior is verified through unit tests and a scratch profile boot.
